ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Government Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate recent allegations of government fraud and follow the money trail to uncover the extent of corruption
questions: What are the sources of funding for government agencies?
How are these funds being allocated?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant corruption and waste within government agencies. By following the money trail, we can identify patterns of fraud and hold those responsible accountable.
